changelog:
Ship moves here from massdo-skills: invoke it with /nestor-beta:ship [list] or $nestor-beta:ship [list].
Build, Ship and Doctor now link Nestor tasks to pull requests through one footer line in the PR description, such as nestor tasks: Xh23, DJ87. Ids and slugs leave branch names, commit subjects and PR titles, and PR titles are in English.
Ship checks titles and footers before a merge, and Doctor finds delivered tasks through that footer only, with no fallback to the former references.
